orchestrator.description: Plans work, writes specs and task briefs, dispatches read-only subagents. Never edits code.

implementer.description: Implements one briefed task inside its own git worktree. Reads brief, writes code, runs tests. No scope decisions.

verifier.description: Independent read-only reviewer. Checks diff against brief and spec, runs build and tests, returns PASS or FAIL.

docs-writer.description: Writes and maintains project docs (pitches, ADRs, specs, changelog) from a brief. Edits docs/ only.

docs-reviewer.description: Independent read-only reviewer for docs-only changes (T0). Checks consistency, metadata, links, sensitive content.

researcher.description: Read-only web researcher. Finds authoritative external guidance (Apple HIG, Swift API Design Guidelines, CLI guidelines, standards).

team-core.description: Feature team for NumioCore (parsing, arithmetic, formatting). Works only in its own worktree and paths. Use after Packages/NumioCore exists (I-001).

team-cli.description: Feature team for the CLI wrapper (argument handling, output, exit codes). Works only in its own worktree and paths. Use after Apps/cli exists (I-001).

brief.description: Turn a short idea into an impact report and a task brief (no code).
brief.template: Create a task brief for: $ARGUMENTS. Follow the brief command instructions in .opencode/commands/brief.md

review.description: Tier-aware review of current changes against a base branch (default main).
review.template: Review changes against base: $ARGUMENTS. Follow the review command instructions in .opencode/commands/review.md

practice-check.description: Quick advisory crew. Checks a question against our rules and external best practices, answers FIX / LEAVE / DECIDE.
practice-check.template: Practice check: $ARGUMENTS. Follow the practice-check command instructions in .opencode/commands/practice-check.md

sync-docs.description: Consolidate Docs impact sections into README/CHANGELOG through the single writer, then review.
sync-docs.template: Sync docs impact sections. Follow the sync-docs command instructions in .opencode/commands/sync-docs.md

feature.description: Run full feature workflow: brief → worktree → implement → verify → deliver.
feature.template: Run feature workflow for: $ARGUMENTS. Follow the feature command instructions in .opencode/commands/feature.md

implement.description: Implement an existing brief in a new worktree (requires brief to exist).
implement.template: Implement brief: $ARGUMENTS. Follow the implement command instructions in .opencode/commands/implement.md

verify.description: Run independent verification of current worktree against brief and spec.
verify.template: Verify worktree against brief: $ARGUMENTS. Follow the verify command instructions in .opencode/commands/verify.md

deliver.description: Finalize worktree: verify, then merge to main (human approval required).
deliver.template: Deliver worktree: $ARGUMENTS. Follow the deliver command instructions in .opencode/commands/deliver.md
